meta.description: Polish, restructure, or translate academic prose into concise Nature-leaning English while preserving facts, evidence boundaries, terminology, and citation intent. Covers manuscript sections (abstract, intro, results, discussion, conclusion, title, methods), paper types (research, methods, hypothesis, algorithmic, review), languages (en, zh-to-en), journals (Nature, Nature Communications, Nature Machine Intelligence), and LaTeX layout fixes. Enforces failure-mode diagnosis (paper type → section job → evidence placement → paragraph necessity → claim/evidence/boundary → sentence polish) and terminology consistency via Ledger.

scientific_integrity.detail: Preserves facts, evidence boundaries, citation intent. Does not invent content to fix structural problems. Terminology Ledger maintains consistency. Consistency sweep catches accumulated drift (terminology, units, numbers, claims contradicted by tables).

practice_boundaries.detail: Appropriate scope for academic prose polishing. Flags structural problems instead of papering over them. Evidence-bound local interpretation. Separates necessary recap from redundant re-demonstration. Main-text discipline prevents bloat.

methodological_ground.detail: Failure-mode diagnosis prioritizes fixes correctly (paper type → section job → evidence placement → paragraph necessity → claim/evidence/boundary → sentence). Claim escalation, fast question funnel, Introduction–Results alignment follow corpus-derived patterns.

code_usability.detail: LaTeX layout guidance (latex-layout.md) with diagnosis workflow (render → contact-sheet → read log), float-glue patterns, multi-panel arrangement. Consistency sweep documented. Section-specific move orders and phrase patterns provided.

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive polishing workflow: four axes (paper_type, section, language, journal) with 5+7+2+4 values. Covers prose polishing, restructuring, translation (Chinese→English), LaTeX layout fixes. Failure-mode diagnosis, terminology ledger, consistency sweep, main-text discipline (evidence placement, revision accretion, claim repetition). Nature-style corpus guidance (abstract, intro, results-discussion). Section-specific guidance (abstract, intro, results, discussion, conclusion, title, methods).

reliability.note: Excellent quality gates: failure-mode diagnosis before editing, prioritized fix order (paper type → section job → evidence placement → paragraph necessity → claim/evidence/boundary → sentence), terminology ledger enforced throughout, consistency sweep for full manuscripts (catches drift, contradictions, prose restating displays), flags structural problems instead of inventing content.

performance_context.note: Efficient progressive loading: only selected axis values loaded (not all fragments), on-demand references (main-text-discipline, nature-results-discussion, nature-introduction, nature-abstract, consistency-sweep, latex-layout). User correction before proceeding (states detected values in one short line).

agent_usability.note: Excellent routing protocol: 5-step workflow with clear axis detection. Failure-mode diagnosis before editing prevents wasted sentence polish on structurally wrong drafts. Prioritized fix order explicit. Terminology ledger cross-cutting. LaTeX layout separate workflow (skip prose axes, render/inspect pages). Corpus-derived patterns distinguished from official policy.

human_usability.note: Strong bilingual support (en, zh-to-en with Chinese-influenced English detection). Journal-specific guidance (Nature flagship, Nature Communications, NMI). Section-specific move orders and phrase patterns. LaTeX layout diagnosis workflow. Bilingual triggers (学术写作, 论文润色, SCI写作, 排版). Version 6.5.0 shows mature evolution.

security.note: Excellent boundaries: does not invent content to fix structural problems, preserves facts and evidence boundaries, flags problems instead of papering over. Terminology ledger prevents inconsistent translations. Corpus-derived patterns labeled as guidance (not official policy). Ethics in always_load.

maintainability.note: Excellent modular design: core stance/failure-modes/output-format stable, four fragment axes (paper_type 5, section 7, language 2, journal 4), on-demand references (10 conditions). Shared nature-shared layer (reader-workflow, paper-type-taxonomy, ethics, terminology-ledger, main-text-discipline, nature-results-discussion, nature-introduction, nature-abstract, consistency-sweep, NMI format). Clear extension points.

agent_specific.note: Strong failure-mode diagnosis workflow. Terminology ledger for consistency. Consistency sweep sophisticated (catches drift, contradictions). Main-text discipline (evidence placement, revision accretion). Minor: no explicit token budget management for very long manuscripts (full thesis, 300+ pages). Corpus-derived patterns documented but not automatically applied (agent must select). No batch mode for polishing multiple sections in parallel.

recommendations.title: Add page density metrics for LaTeX sparse-page validation
recommendations.problem: LaTeX layout workflow fixes 'sparse pages' and 'stranded headings' but lacks explicit metrics for validation. Agent must judge visually without quantitative threshold. What constitutes 'sparse' (lines per page, whitespace percentage) not defined.
recommendations.root_cause: latex-layout.md provides diagnosis workflow and fix patterns but no density metrics.
recommendations.fix: Add to latex-layout.md: (1) sparse page metric: <20 lines of text per page or >60% whitespace, (2) stranded heading: section heading with <3 lines of content before page break, (3) validation script (Python) that parses rendered PDF, counts lines per page, measures whitespace, flags violations. Include in diagnosis workflow as quantitative check before and after fixes. Document acceptable density range (25-40 lines per page for standard single-column).

recommendations.title: Add automatic corpus-pattern application with user override
recommendations.problem: Corpus-derived patterns (Nature abstract compression, Results-Discussion claim escalation, fast question funnel) documented but agent must manually select and apply. No automatic application with user override. Inconsistent application across different sections.
recommendations.root_cause: Patterns provided as reference guidance, not operationalized in workflow.
recommendations.fix: Add scripts/apply_corpus_patterns.py that: (1) detects applicable patterns from axis values (nature journal + abstract → discovery-centred compression), (2) applies pattern transformations (abstract: extract main claim, select two decisive supports, compute compression ratio), (3) generates before/after diff for user review, (4) user can accept/reject/modify. Include pattern library (JSON) with transformation rules. Document in routing protocol as optional automated step before manual polish.

recommendations.title: Add batch mode for parallel section polishing
recommendations.problem: Workflow polishes sections sequentially. For full manuscript, polishing abstract → intro → results → discussion → conclusion in sequence is time-consuming. No guidance for parallel section processing when sections are independent.
recommendations.root_cause: Single-task workflow design. Terminology ledger shared across sections requires sequential processing for consistency.
recommendations.fix: Add references/parallel-polishing-strategy.md: (1) identify independent sections (abstract, methods can be polished in parallel with results, discussion), (2) dispatch subagents for independent sections with shared terminology ledger seed, (3) merge terminology updates from parallel polishing, (4) consistency sweep after merge to catch conflicts. Include token budget estimation (50k per section baseline). Document when parallel worth overhead (>4 sections, >10k words total).
